baseline.source: Godot 4.7.2 original track_map.gd redraws static circuit as part of every cars-only _draw()

optimized.source: Godot 4.7.2 script instrumentation in headless mode

high_speed_test.note: Headless scripted _process time, not physical display FPS or a matched full-hardware benchmark

conclusion: The background cache prevents redundant geometry redraws, but frame wall time did not measurably improve in capped 180-frame benchmark. 32x CPU workload still limits FPS.
